command:
set -eu
if [ -e /swapfile ]; then ls -lZ /swapfile; file /swapfile; else printf '%s\n' '/swapfile is absent'; fi
grep -nE '(^|[[:space:]])/swapfile([[:space:]]|$)' /etc/fstab || true
command -v mkswap
command -v swapon

set -eu
if [ -e /swapfile ]; then ls -lZ /swapfile; file /swapfile; else printf '%s\n' '/swapfile is absent'; fi
grep -nE '(^|[[:space:]])/swapfile([[:space:]]|$)' /etc/fstab || true
command -v mkswap
command -v swapon

set -eu
umask 077
dd if=/dev/zero of=/swapfile bs=1M count=512 status=none
chmod 600 /swapfile
restorecon -v /swapfile || true
ls -lhZ /swapfile
stat -c 'bytes=%s mode=%a blocks=%b block_size=%B' /swapfile

command:
set -eu
swapoff /swapfile
systemctl daemon-reload
swapon -a
printf '%s\n' '== swap after fstab-only reactivation =='
swapon --show
printf '%s\n' '== generated unit =='
systemctl is-enabled swapfile.swap
systemctl is-active swapfile.swap
systemctl show swapfile.swap -p What -p Priority -p ActiveState -p SubState --no-pager
